# Lockers and traction aids

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install an air-activated locker into the differential with a matching 33-spline axle. [t1564]

[Partial] Connect Solenoid 1 and then Solenoid 2 to engage the front locker after the rear. [t1240]

[Partial] Connect an air line from a power tank or compressor to engage the pressure that locks both wheels together. [t1477]

Install a rear locker into the differential that re-uses existing side gears with 31 or 33 spline compatibility. [t1352]

Install the Lokka auto-locker into the front differential and ensure cam gears mesh. [t2061]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Install an air-activated locker into the differential.
2. [Partial] Ensure the axle has a 33-spline inner shaft to match the locker.

_Procedure reported by [t1564]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1240] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Follow the manufacturer's wiring instructions to connect Solenoid 1 for the rear locker.
2. Connect Solenoid 2 for the front locker so it can only actuate when Solenoid 1 is already engaged.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1352] [Partial]</summary>

1. Install the PowerTrax or Nitro rear locker into the differential.
2. Ensure the unit re-uses the existing side gears from the carrier.

</details>

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t2061] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Install the Lokka auto-locker into the front differential.
2. Ensure cam gears mesh with axle gears to lock both tires at the same RPM.

</details>

## Specifications

- **Axle gear ratio**: 4.9 [t1564] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Locker spline count**: 33 [t1564] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Spline compatibility (Side gears)**: 31 or 33 [t1352] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a Powertank with a manifold to hook up lines for both front and rear lockers if running two. [t1477]
- Consider installing manual hubs on the front end before adding a front locker. [t1477]
- Use with manual hubs to dial one side out for tight turns on slippery ground. [t2061]
- [Partial] Consider a front diff drop if the locker installation requires it. [t2061]
